runs.answer:

Here are the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet on 20 June 2026 (UTC) — the `first_seen_ms` column shows how many milliseconds after slot start the first node observed each block:

| slot | block_root | first_seen_ms | slot_start_date_time |
|---|---|---|---|
| 14590799 | `0xdbcc…` | 1773 | 2026-06-20 00:00:11 |
| 14590800 | `0x9441…` | 3142 | 2026-06-20 00:00:23 |
| 14590801 | `0xa303…` | 1609 | 2026-06-20 00:00:35 |
| ... | ... | ... | ... |
| 14590848 | `0x8482…` | 1847 | 2026-06-20 00:09:59 |
